title: DevvStream Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: DevvStream Corp. received a Nasdaq delisting notice on April 7, 2026 because its stock price closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days (February 23 – April 6, 2026), violating Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The company is ineligible for standard compliance periods due to a prior reverse stock split and intends to request a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel.
key_points: DevvStream Corp. (ticker: DEVS) received a Nasdaq delisting notice on April 7, 2026 for failing to maintain a $1.00 minimum bid price over 30 consecutive business days.
The non-compliance period was February 23, 2026 through April 6, 2026.
Company is ineligible for standard compliance grace periods under Nasdaq Rule 5810(c)(3)(A)(iv) due to a reverse stock split executed within the prior one-year period.
DevvStream Corp. intends to timely request a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel to contest the delisting determination.
A hearing request automatically stays any suspension or delisting action pending the Panel's decision.
